SEATTLE · 10 PHOTOS

Seattle, outside.

I have some gripes with Seattle, but one of my favourite things about the city is how beautiful it is. Sometimes it’s easy to forget how privileged I am to be living in a place like this and some of the photos remind me to be grateful for my home and community.
